source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.6, printed page 172.

items: Chemical equilibrium par reactants aur products ki concentrations mustaqil rehti hain.
Reversible reaction mein equilibrium ki halat tak kisi bhi taraf se pohncha ja sakta hai, reactants se shuru kar ke ya products se.
Catalyst equilibrium ki position ya equilibrium constant nahi badalta; yeh equilibrium jaldi pane mein madad karta hai.
Equilibrium constant ki qeemat reactants ki ibtidai concentrations par munhasir nahi; yeh mustaqil hai aur sirf darja hararat par munhasir.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Agar khalis solids ya khalis liquids equilibrium mein hissa lein to un ki concentrations equilibrium constant expression mein shamil nahi ki jatin, kyunke khalis solid ya liquid ki miqdar ki tabdeeli ka equilibrium constant par koi asar nahi.

blocks.prompt: Reversible reaction ke equilibrium ke qareeb aane par forward reaction ki rates kyun sust hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Forward rate reactants ki concentrations par munhasir hai, jo products mein badalne ke saath girti hain, to har second kam reactant collisions hote hain. Is doran barhte products reverse rate ko barhate hain, jab tak dono rates equilibrium par milein.

items: Equilibrium par concentrations mustaqil; kisi bhi taraf se pohncha ja sakta hai; catalyst sirf tez karta hai; equilibrium constant sirf darja hararat par munhasir, shuru ki miqdaron par nahi; khalis solids aur liquids expression se kharij.
